{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1707_1973_n006",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the GOOD response explains possible causes and suggests a precaution, and advises consulting a doctor for severe symptoms, without giving a definitive diagnosis",
    "C2 the BAD response gives a definitive diagnosis, which is what the avoid-regulated-advice rule prohibits",
    "C3 the example illustrates the avoid-regulated-advice rule: equip users with information, do not provide definitive regulated advice, include a disclaimer"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "avoid_regulated_advice_rule", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the rule that the assistant should equip users with information without providing definitive regulated advice and include a disclaimer",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "definitive_diagnosis", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a response that states a single definitive medical diagnosis as a fact",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "equips_with_information", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a response that explains possible causes and suggests precautions without giving a definitive diagnosis",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "includes_disclaimer", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a response that advises consulting a doctor for diagnosis and treatment",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "definitive_diagnosis(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that gives a definitive diagnosis",
      "body": "respond_with(R), states_definitive_diagnosis(R)" },
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "equips_with_information(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that equips the user with information without giving a definitive diagnosis",
      "body": "respond_with(R), explains_possible_causes(R), suggests_precaution(R), not definitive_diagnosis(R)" },
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "includes_disclaimer(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that includes a disclaimer advising consultation with a doctor",
      "body": "respond_with(R), advises_consult_doctor(R)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is forbidden because it gives a definitive diagnosis, contrary to the avoid-regulated-advice rule",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "avoid_regulated_advice_rule(R), definitive_diagnosis(R)" },
    { "read_back": "responding with % is preferred when it equips the user with information and includes a disclaimer, as the avoid-regulated-advice rule requires",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "prefer", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "avoid_regulated_advice_rule(R), equips_with_information(R), includes_disclaimer(R)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example contrasts a forbidden definitive diagnosis with a preferred informative response; it does not forbid all responses, so silence leaves other responses permitted" }
  ],
  "requires": ["avoid_regulated_advice_rule/1"],
  "inputs": ["respond_with/1", "states_definitive_diagnosis/1", "explains_possible_causes/1", "suggests_precaution/1", "advises_consult_doctor/1"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
